list.emptyActiveHint: Tap + to write your first note.
list.emptyTrashHint: Deleted notes stay here for {{days}} days, then they're deleted for good.
list.noResultsHint: Try another word or clear the color filter.

trash.confirmBody: Every note in the trash will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
trash.inTrash: This note is in the trash
trash.hint: Notes stay in the trash for {{days}} days, then they're deleted for good.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Notes are stored on this device, and in the cloud while you're signed in. A backup file protects them if the browser data is cleared or something goes wrong.
settings.errorInvalidJson: That file can't be read. It isn't a valid backup.
settings.errorNotBackup: That file isn't a ToDo backup.
settings.errorUnsupportedVersion: This backup is from a newer version. Update the app and try again.
settings.storageOn: Protected. The browser won't clear your notes to free up space.
settings.storageOff: Not protected. The browser may clear your notes when storage runs low. Make a backup.
settings.storageUnknown: This browser doesn't support data protection requests.
settings.storageDenied: The browser said no. Installing the app to your home screen often helps.

groups.title: Groups
groups.name: Name
groups.deleteBody: The notes aren't deleted. They just stay without a group.
groups.empty: No notes in this group yet
groups.emptyHint: Tap + and the new note will be created in this group.
groups.noteColorHint: New notes in this group start with this colour. You can always change it by hand in the note.

account.title: Account
account.unavailable: The account part couldn't load. Try again later.
account.intro: Signing in lets you see your notes on other devices too. Notes sync automatically.
account.resetSent: A password reset email was sent to {{email}}. Check your inbox and spam. It may arrive in English.
account.resetNeedsEmail: Enter a valid email first to reset the password.
account.errorEmailFormat: That email doesn't look right. For example: name@example.com
account.errorPasswordShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
account.errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
account.errorTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
account.errorNotAllowed: This sign-in method isn't enabled in Firebase.
account.emailOwnPassword: This is a separate password for this app, not your Google password. Make up a new one.
account.errorPopupBlocked: The browser blocked Google's window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
account.errorDomain: This address isn't added in Firebase (Authorized domains).
account.errorDifferentMethod: You already have an account with this email using another method. Sign in with that.

sync.follower: Syncing is running in another window of this app.
sync.conflicts_one: {{count}} copy was made: one note changed on both devices and no text was lost. Look for “(copy)” in the title.
sync.conflicts_other: {{count}} copies were made: notes changed on both devices and no text was lost. Look for “(copy)” in the titles.
sync.errorPermission: The rules don't allow access. Paste docs/firestore.rules into Firestore → Rules and publish.
sync.errorOffline: No connection. Changes will upload when the internet is back.
sync.errorQuota: Today's free limit is used up. It continues tomorrow.
sync.mismatchTitle: This phone holds another account's notes
sync.mismatchBody: There are already notes here that belong to a different account, so they are not merged. You can sign out, or delete this phone's notes (a backup file is downloaded first) and start with this account.
sync.mismatchConfirmBody: A backup file is downloaded first, then every note and group on this phone is deleted and this account's notes come in.

snapshots.title: Backups
snapshots.intro: The last state of each day is saved when you leave the app (close it or switch to another). The last {{count}} backups are kept: the oldest goes when a new one is added, and backups aren't lost if you don't open the app for a long time. A backup made with no internet is uploaded the next time you open the app and keeps the date of the day it was made.
snapshots.empty: No backups yet. The first one is made today automatically.
snapshots.toTrash: Made after that day, going to the trash: {{count}}
snapshots.safety: Before restoring, a copy of the present state is saved and shown in the list as “Before restore”. So a restore can be undone.
snapshots.restoreWhole: Restore the app to that day
snapshots.restoreMissingHint: Leaves current notes alone: only what you no longer have, or what's in the trash, comes back.
snapshots.confirmBody: The present state is saved as a backup first. Notes changed since that day go back to that day's text; notes made since go to the trash. On every device.
snapshots.errorGeneric: Something is wrong with backups ({{code}}). Try again later.
snapshots.errorBroken: This backup is damaged and can't be read. Nothing was changed.
snapshots.errorAuto: The automatic backup couldn't be made ({{code}}). Try “Back up now”.
snapshots.waiting: {{count}} backup is waiting to be uploaded. It goes when the internet is back or when you open the app.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyHint: Tap + and the new note gets this date.
